name: Supino Reto na Máquina (Sentado / Vertical)
muscles: Peitoral maior, deltoide anterior e tríceps
movement: Seated upright on a fixed-path weight-stack chest press machine, back against vertical pad, feet planted. Pronated handles move forward horizontally from chest height to almost straight elbows and return. Machine arms stay parallel, not converging.
cue: Ajuste o banco para manter os pegadores na altura do peito. Apoie as costas e os pés, empurre os braços da máquina à frente e retorne controlando a carga.
